questions.title: Read and interpret letter
questions.instructions: Please take a moment to read the 2-page letter. You can zoom in/out to adjust the font size to the level you’re comfortable with. Once you’ve finished, we’d like you to talk out loud and tell us:
prompts: What you understand from the letter (provide as much detail as possible)
What, if anything, the letter asks you to do and why
What, if anything, you found confusing or unclear

questions.title: Correct incoming payment
questions.instructions: We’d like you to imagine you are correcting one of the payments and would like to find the right details to use. (This is a test of the letter, not you)
prompts: Imagine you want to continue receiving the payment from Mr & Mrs Johnson. Please talk out loud about what you would do and what information you would use.

questions.title: Compare the sections on page 2
questions.instructions: Please look at page 2 of the letter.
prompts: What is the difference between the information under “Summary of the payment(s)” and the information under “The correct account details”?
